page.title: OAuth grants
page.description: Applications people have signed in to and let keep them signed in. Revoking a grant ends it: the application has to send the person through sign-in again.

truncated.title: Showing the latest {{n}} grants
truncated.description: Qeet ID lists up to 1,000 at a time. Older ones are still live; filter by application to see them.

revoke.oneDescription: {{app}} can't renew {{person}}'s sign-in any more and has to send them through sign-in again. The access token it holds keeps working until it expires, within minutes.
revoke.manyDescription: Each application can't renew those people's sign-ins any more and has to send them through sign-in again. Access tokens they hold keep working until they expire, within minutes.
revoke.someFailed_one: {{count}} grant couldn't be revoked. Try again.
revoke.someFailed_other: {{count}} grants couldn't be revoked. Try again.

empty.title: No grants yet
empty.description: A grant appears when someone signs in to one of your applications and it keeps them signed in.
empty.filteredDescription: Search covers people's names and emails. Try another search or clear the filters.
